 * Register Map & Bit Definitions (ARMv8-A MMIO, 32-bit aligned)
 * Base: 0x4000_1000
 * ============================================================================ */
#define PERIPH_BASE_ADDR        (0x40001000u)
#define PERIPH_MAP_SIZE         (4096u) /* 4KB Page */

#define REG_CTRL_OFFSET         (0x00u)
#define REG_STATUS_OFFSET       (0x04u) /* Write-1-to-Clear (W1C) */
#define REG_DATA_OFFSET         (0x08u)
#define REG_IRQ_MASK_OFFSET     (0x0Cu)

/* CTRL Register Bits */
#define CTRL_ENABLE_BIT         (1u << 0)
#define CTRL_IRQ_EN_BIT         (1u << 1)
#define CTRL_START_BIT          (1u << 2)
#define CTRL_RESET_BIT          (1u << 3)

/* STATUS Register Bits (W1C for sticky bits) */
#define STATUS_DONE_BIT         (1u << 0) /* W1C */
#define STATUS_ERROR_BIT        (1u << 1) /* W1C */
#define STATUS_BUSY_BIT         (1u << 2) /* Read-Only */
#define STATUS_W1C_MASK         (STATUS_DONE_BIT | STATUS_ERROR_BIT)

/* ============================================================================
 * Driver Types & Error Codes
 * ============================================================================ */
typedef enum {
    DRV_OK = 0,
    DRV_ERR_NULL_PTR,
    DRV_ERR_TIMEOUT,
    DRV_ERR_HW_FAULT
} drv_status_t;

typedef struct {
    volatile uint32_t *base;
} periph_dev_t;

/* ============================================================================
 * Static Inline Register Accessors (Memory Barriers implicit via volatile)
 * ============================================================================ */
static inline uint32_t reg_read(volatile const uint32_t *addr) {
    return *addr;
}

static inline void reg_write(volatile uint32_t *addr, uint32_t val) {
    *addr = val;
}

static inline void reg_set_bits(volatile uint32_t *addr, uint32_t mask) {
    *addr |= mask;
}

static inline void reg_clear_bits(volatile uint32_t *addr, uint32_t mask) {
    *addr &= ~mask;
}

/* W1C Specific: Write '1' to clear specific status bits */
static inline void status_clear_w1c(periph_dev_t *dev, uint32_t bits_to_clear) {
    assert((bits_to_clear & ~STATUS_W1C_MASK) == 0);
    reg_write(&dev->base[REG_STATUS_OFFSET / 4], bits_to_clear);
}

/* ============================================================================
 * Driver API
 * ============================================================================ */
drv_status_t periph_init(periph_dev_t *dev, uintptr_t base_addr) {
    if (!dev) return DRV_ERR_NULL_PTR;
    dev->base = (volatile uint32_t *)base_addr;
    
    /* Hardware Reset Sequence */
    reg_write(&dev->base[REG_CTRL_OFFSET / 4], CTRL_RESET_BIT);
    /* Poll for reset clear (max 16 cycles @ 100MHz = 160ns) */
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 16; ++i) {
        if ((reg_read(&dev->base[REG_CTRL_OFFSET / 4]) & CTRL_RESET_BIT) == 0) break;
        __asm__ volatile ("yield" ::: "memory"); /* Arch hint for polling */
    }
    reg_write(&dev->base[REG_IRQ_MASK_OFFSET / 4], 0x0);
    return DRV_OK;
}

drv_status_t periph_enable(periph_dev_t *dev, bool enable_irq) {
    if (!dev) return DRV_ERR_NULL_PTR;
    uint32_t ctrl = CTRL_ENABLE_BIT;
    if (enable_irq) ctrl |= CTRL_IRQ_EN_BIT;
    reg_write(&dev->base[REG_CTRL_OFFSET / 4], ctrl);
    return DRV_OK;
}

drv_status_t periph_write_data(periph_dev_t *dev, uint32_t data) {
    if (!dev) return DRV_ERR_NULL_PTR;
    reg_write(&dev->base[REG_DATA_OFFSET / 4], data);
    return DRV_OK;
}

drv_status_t periph_start_op(periph_dev_t *dev) {
    if (!dev) return DRV_ERR_NULL_PTR;
    reg_set_bits(&dev->base[REG_CTRL_OFFSET / 4], CTRL_START_BIT);
    return DRV_OK;
}

/* Poll STATUS with 16-cycle exponential backoff (1, 2, 4, 8... capped at 16 total) */
drv_status_t periph_wait_done(periph_dev_t *dev, uint32_t *out_status) {
    if (!dev || !out_status) return DRV_ERR_NULL_PTR;
    
    uint32_t status = 0;
    uint32_t total_cycles = 0;
    uint32_t backoff = 1;

    while (total_cycles < 16) {
        status = reg_read(&dev->base[REG_STATUS_OFFSET / 4]);
        
        if (status & STATUS_ERROR_BIT) return DRV_ERR_HW_FAULT;
        if (status & STATUS_DONE_BIT) {
            *out_status = status;
            return DRV_OK;
        }

        /* Busy wait backoff */
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < backoff; ++i) {
            __asm__ volatile ("yield" ::: "memory");
        }
        total_cycles += backoff;
        if (backoff < 8) backoff <<= 1; /* Cap backoff step */
    }
    return DRV_ERR_TIMEOUT;
}

drv_status_t periph_clear_status(periph_dev_t *dev, uint32_t bits) {
    if (!dev) return DRV_ERR_NULL_PTR;
    status_clear_w1c(dev, bits & STATUS_W1C_MASK);
    return DRV_OK;
}

uint32_t periph_get_status(const periph_dev_t *dev) {
    return reg_read(&dev->base[REG_STATUS_OFFSET / 4]);
}

/* ============================================================================
 * Simulated Hardware Model (Deterministic Backing Store for Test Harness)
 * ============================================================================ */
typedef struct {
    uint32_t mem[PERIPH_MAP_SIZE / 4];
    bool op_pending;
    uint32_t op_cycles_remaining;
} sim_hw_t;

static void sim_hw_reset(sim_hw_t *hw) {
    for (size_t i = 0; i < PERIPH_MAP_SIZE / 4; ++i) hw->mem[i] = 0;
    hw->op_pending = false;
    hw->op_cycles_remaining = 0;
    /* STATUS: BUSY=0, DONE=0, ERROR=0 */
}

static void sim_hw_tick(sim_hw_t *hw) {
    /* Simulate CTRL write side-effects */
    uint32_t ctrl = hw->mem[REG_CTRL_OFFSET / 4];
    uint32_t *status = &hw->mem[REG_STATUS_OFFSET / 4];

    if (ctrl & CTRL_RESET_BIT) {
        *status = 0;
        hw->mem[REG_CTRL_OFFSET / 4] &= ~CTRL_RESET_BIT; /* Self-clear */
        hw->op_pending = false;
        return;
    }

    if ((ctrl & CTRL_ENABLE_BIT) && (ctrl & CTRL_START_BIT) && !hw->op_pending) {
        hw->op_pending = true;
        hw->op_cycles_remaining = 5; /* Simulated latency: 5 cycles */
        *status |= STATUS_BUSY_BIT;
        hw->mem[REG_CTRL_OFFSET / 4] &= ~CTRL_START_BIT; /* Self-clear START */
    }

    if (hw->op_pending) {
        if (hw->op_cycles_remaining == 0) {
            *status &= ~STATUS_BUSY_BIT;
            *status |= STATUS_DONE_BIT; /* Set W1C Done bit */
            if (hw->mem[REG_DATA_OFFSET / 4] == 0xDEADBEEF) {
                *status |= STATUS_ERROR_BIT; /* Simulate error condition */
            }
            hw->op_pending = false;
        } else {
            hw->op_cycles_remaining--;
        }
    }

    /* Simulate W1C Behavior on STATUS Register Write */
    /* In real HW, write to STATUS clears bits where '1' is written. */
    /* Our driver writes to STATUS offset to clear. We intercept here. */
    /* Note: The driver writes to the STATUS address. The sim must detect write. */
    /* Since we are single-threaded simulation, we check if driver called clear. */
    /* The driver calls status_clear_w1c which writes 'bits' to STATUS addr. */
    /* We simulate this by checking the write in the test harness sequence directly, 
       or by making the backing store 'smart'. For simplicity, test harness 
       manually applies W1C logic after driver call. */
}

/* ============================================================================
 * Test Harness (Deterministic main)
 * ============================================================================ */
int main(void) {
    /* 1. Allocate Page-Aligned Backing Store */
    alignas(PERIPH_MAP_SIZE) static uint8_t backing_store[PERIPH_MAP_SIZE];
    assert(((uintptr_t)backing_store % PERIPH_MAP_SIZE) == 0);

    sim_hw_t hw;
    sim_hw_reset(&hw);
    /* Map simulated registers to backing store */
    uint32_t *regs = (uint32_t *)backing_store;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < PERIPH_MAP_SIZE / 4; ++i) regs[i] = hw.mem[i];

    periph_dev_t dev;
    drv_status_t ret;

    /* 2. Driver Init */
    ret = periph_init(&dev, (uintptr_t)backing_store);
    assert(ret == DRV_OK);
    assert((regs[REG_CTRL_OFFSET/4] & CTRL_RESET_BIT) == 0);

    /* 3. Enable Peripheral (No IRQ) */
    ret = periph_enable(&dev, false);
    assert(ret == DRV_OK);
    assert(regs[REG_CTRL_OFFSET/4] & CTRL_ENABLE_BIT);

    /* 4. Write Data & Start Operation */
    ret = periph_write_data(&dev, 0xCAFEBABE);
    assert(ret == DRV_OK);
    assert(regs[REG_DATA_OFFSET/4] == 0xCAFEBABE);

    ret = periph_start_op(&dev);
    assert(ret == DRV_OK);

    /* 5. Simulate Hardware Progression (Driver polls, HW ticks) */
    uint32_t final_status = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 20; ++i) { /* Max 20 ticks simulation time */
        /* Update Sim HW State based on current register shadow */
        hw.mem[REG_CTRL_OFFSET/4] = regs[REG_CTRL_OFFSET/4];
        hw.mem[REG_DATA_OFFSET/4] = regs[REG_DATA_OFFSET/4];
        hw.mem[REG_STATUS_OFFSET/4] = regs[REG_STATUS_OFFSET/4];
        hw.mem[REG_IRQ_MASK_OFFSET/4] = regs[REG_IRQ_MASK_OFFSET/4];
        
        sim_hw_tick(&hw);
        
        /* Push back to backing store (Registers are volatile, HW updates STATUS) */
        regs[REG_STATUS_OFFSET/4] = hw.mem[REG_STATUS_OFFSET/4];
        regs[REG_CTRL_OFFSET/4] = hw.mem[REG_CTRL_OFFSET/4];

        /* Driver Poll Attempt */
        ret = periph_wait_done(&dev, &final_status);
        if (ret == DRV_OK) break;
        if (ret == DRV_ERR_HW_FAULT) break;
    }

    assert(ret == DRV_OK);
    assert(final_status & STATUS_DONE_BIT);
    assert((final_status & STATUS_ERROR_BIT) == 0); /* Data was 0xCAFEBABE */
    assert((final_status & STATUS_BUSY_BIT) == 0);

    /* 6. Test W1C Clear Mechanism */
    /* Driver writes bits-to-clear to STATUS register */
    ret = periph_clear_status(&dev, STATUS_DONE_BIT);
    assert(ret == DRV_OK);
    
    /* Simulate HW W1C Logic: STATUS &= ~bits_written */
    regs[REG_STATUS_OFFSET/4] &= ~STATUS_DONE_BIT; 
    assert((periph_get_status(&dev) & STATUS_DONE_BIT) == 0);

    /* 7. Test Error Path */
    sim_hw_reset(&hw);
    for (size_t i = 0; i < PERIPH_MAP_SIZE / 4; ++i) regs[i] = hw.mem[i];
    periph_init(&dev, (uintptr_t)backing_store);
    periph_enable(&dev, false);
    periph_write_data(&dev, 0xDEADBEEF); /* Trigger Error */
    periph_start_op(&dev);
    
    ret = DRV_ERR_TIMEOUT;
    for (int i = 0; i < 20; ++i) {
        hw.mem[REG_CTRL_OFFSET/4] = regs[REG_CTRL_OFFSET/4];
        hw.mem[REG_DATA_OFFSET/4] = regs[REG_DATA_OFFSET/4];
        hw.mem[REG_STATUS_OFFSET/4] = regs[REG_STATUS_OFFSET/4];
        sim_hw_tick(&hw);
        regs[REG_STATUS_OFFSET/4] = hw.mem[REG_STATUS_OFFSET/4];
        regs[REG_CTRL_OFFSET/4] = hw.mem[REG_CTRL_OFFSET/4];
        ret = periph_wait_done(&dev, &final_status);
        if (ret != DRV_ERR_TIMEOUT) break;
    }
    assert(ret == DRV_ERR_HW_FAULT);
    assert(final_status & STATUS_ERROR_BIT);
    periph_clear_status(&dev, STATUS_ERROR_BIT);
    regs[REG_STATUS_OFFSET/4] &= ~STATUS_ERROR_BIT;
    assert((periph_get_status(&dev) & STATUS_ERROR_BIT) == 0);

    return 0;
}
```

**Complexity**:  
Time: O(1) per register operation. Polling `periph_wait_done` is O(1) bounded by constant 16 cycles (hardware constraint).  
Space: O(1) driver state (pointer only). Test harness uses O(4KB) static aligned buffer.

#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdbool.h>
#include <stddef.h>
#include <assert.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <stdio.h>

#define PERIPH_BASE_ADDR        0x40001000UL
#define PERIPH_SIZE             0x1000UL
#define PAGE_SIZE               0x1000UL
#define BURST_ALIGNMENT         64U

#define REG_CTRL                0x00U
#define REG_STATUS              0x04U
#define REG_DATA                0x08U
#define REG_IRQ_MASK            0x0CU

#define CTRL_ENABLE             (1U << 0)
#define CTRL_DMA_EN             (1U << 1)
#define CTRL_IRQ_EN             (1U << 2)
#define CTRL_SW_RESET           (1U << 31)

#define STATUS_DONE             (1U << 0)
#define STATUS_ERROR            (1U << 1)
#define STATUS_FIFO_FULL        (1U << 2)
#define STATUS_FIFO_EMPTY       (1U << 3)
#define STATUS_DMA_COMPLETE     (1U << 4)
#define STATUS_W1C_MASK         (STATUS_DONE | STATUS_ERROR | STATUS_DMA_COMPLETE)

static inline void dmb_ish(void) {
    __asm__ volatile ("dmb ish" ::: "memory");
}

static inline void dsb_ish(void) {
    __asm__ volatile ("dsb ish" ::: "memory");
}

static inline void isb(void) {
    __asm__ volatile ("isb" ::: "memory");
}

typedef struct {
    uint32_t ctrl;
    uint32_t status;
    uint32_t data;
    uint32_t irq_mask;
} __attribute__((packed, aligned(4))) peripheral_regs_t;

static uint8_t simulated_mmio[PERIPH_SIZE] __attribute__((aligned(PAGE_SIZE)));
static peripheral_regs_t *const periph = (peripheral_regs_t *)simulated_mmio;

static inline uint32_t mmio_read32(volatile const uint32_t *addr) {
    uint32_t val = *addr;
    dmb_ish();
    return val;
}

static inline void mmio_write32(volatile uint32_t *addr, uint32_t val) {
    dmb_ish();
    *addr = val;
    dsb_ish();
}

static inline bool is_aligned_64(const void *ptr) {
    return ((uintptr_t)ptr & (BURST_ALIGNMENT - 1)) == 0;
}

void periph_ctrl_write(uint32_t value) {
    mmio_write32(&periph->ctrl, value);
}

uint32_t periph_ctrl_read(void) {
    return mmio_read32(&periph->ctrl);
}

uint32_t periph_status_read(void) {
    return mmio_read32(&periph->status);
}

void periph_status_clear(uint32_t bits) {
    mmio_write32(&periph->status, bits & STATUS_W1C_MASK);
}

uint32_t periph_status_read_clear(void) {
    uint32_t status = mmio_read32(&periph->status);
    if (status & STATUS_W1C_MASK) {
        mmio_write32(&periph->status, status & STATUS_W1C_MASK);
    }
    return status;
}

void periph_data_write(uint32_t value) {
    mmio_write32(&periph->data, value);
}

uint32_t periph_data_read(void) {
    return mmio_read32(&periph->data);
}

void periph_irq_mask_write(uint32_t mask) {
    mmio_write32(&periph->irq_mask, mask);
}

uint32_t periph_irq_mask_read(void) {
    return mmio_read32(&periph->irq_mask);
}

void periph_enable(bool enable) {
    uint32_t ctrl = periph_ctrl_read();
    if (enable) {
        ctrl |= CTRL_ENABLE;
    } else {
        ctrl &= ~CTRL_ENABLE;
    }
    periph_ctrl_write(ctrl);
}

void periph_dma_enable(bool enable) {
    uint32_t ctrl = periph_ctrl_read();
    if (enable) {
        ctrl |= CTRL_DMA_EN;
    } else {
        ctrl &= ~CTRL_DMA_EN;
    }
    periph_ctrl_write(ctrl);
}

void periph_irq_enable(bool enable) {
    uint32_t ctrl = periph_ctrl_read();
    if (enable) {
        ctrl |= CTRL_IRQ_EN;
    } else {
        ctrl &= ~CTRL_IRQ_EN;
    }
    periph_ctrl_write(ctrl);
}

void periph_soft_reset(void) {
    periph_ctrl_write(CTRL_SW_RESET);
    dsb_ish();
    isb();
    while (periph_ctrl_read() & CTRL_SW_RESET) {
        __asm__ volatile ("yield" ::: "memory");
    }

    if (!is_aligned_64(src)) {
        return false;
    }
    if ((count * sizeof(uint32_t)) % BURST_ALIGNMENT != 0) {
        return false;

    for (size_t i = 0; i < count; i++) {

    return true;

    if ((count * sizeof(uint32_t)) % BURST_ALIGNMENT != 0) {
        return false;
    }

    for (size_t i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        dst[i] = periph_data_read();
    }
    return true;
}

    periph->status = STATUS_FIFO_EMPTY;

    periph->status |= (bits & STATUS_W1C_MASK);

    periph_status_clear(STATUS_DMA_COMPLETE);
    assert((periph_status_read() & STATUS_DMA_COMPLETE) == 0);

    uint32_t aligned_buffer[16] __attribute__((aligned(BURST_ALIGNMENT)));

    assert(periph_write_burst(unaligned_buffer, 16) == false);
    assert(periph_read_burst(unaligned_buffer, 16) == false);

    periph_soft_reset();
    assert(periph_ctrl_read() == 0);
    assert(periph_status_read() == STATUS_FIFO_EMPTY);

    printf("All tests passed.\n");
    return 0;

#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <cassert>
#include <cmath>
#include <iomanip>
#include <iostream>
#include <limits>
#include <vector>

namespace s2::geodesy {

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// WGS84 Ellipsoid Constants & Authalic Sphere Mapping
// ------------------------------------------------------------
struct WGS84 {
    static constexpr long double a     = 6378137.0L;           // Semi-major axis (m)
    static constexpr long double f     = 1.0L / 298.257223563L; // Flattening
    static constexpr long double e2    = 2.0L * f - f * f;     // Eccentricity squared
    static constexpr long double e     = std::sqrt(e2);
    static constexpr long double q_p   = (1.0L - e2) * (std::atanh(e) / e - 1.0L); // Polar authalic integral factor
    // Authalic Radius R2: Area(Sphere) = Area(Ellipsoid)
    static constexpr long double R2    = a * std::sqrt(0.5L * (1.0L + (1.0L - e2) / (2.0L * e) * std::log((1.0L + e) / (1.0L - e))));
    static constexpr long double R2_SQ = R2 * R2;
    static constexpr long double PI    = std::acos(-1.0L);
    static constexpr long double DEG2RAD = PI / 180.0L;
    static constexpr long double RAD2DEG = 180.0L / PI;
};

// Clamp for numerical safety in asin/acos
inline long double clamp(long double v, long double lo, long double hi) {
    return std::max(lo, std::min(hi, v));
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// Geodetic -> Authalic Latitude Conversion (Area Preserving)
// ------------------------------------------------------------
inline long double geodeticToAuthalicLat(long double phi) {
    // q(phi) = (1-e^2) * ( sin(phi)/(1-e^2 sin^2 phi) - 1/(2e) ln((1-e sin phi)/(1+e sin phi)) )
    // beta = asin( q(phi) / q_p )
    long double sin_phi = std::sin(phi);
    long double e = WGS84::e;
    long double e2 = WGS84::e2;
    long double con = e * sin_phi;
    long double q;
    if (std::fabsl(con) >= 1.0L - std::numeric_limits<long double>::epsilon()) {
        q = (phi > 0 ? 1.0L : -1.0L) * WGS84::q_p; // Poles
    } else {
        q = (1.0L - e2) * (sin_phi / (1.0L - e2 * sin_phi * sin_phi) 
                           - (1.0L / (2.0L * e)) * std::log((1.0L - con) / (1.0L + con)));
    }
    return std::asin(clamp(q / WGS84::q_p, -1.0L, 1.0L));
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// Spherical Trigonometry Primitives (on Authalic Sphere R2)
// ------------------------------------------------------------
struct SphericalPoint {
    long double beta; // Authalic latitude
    long double lambda; // Longitude
    SphericalPoint() = default;
    SphericalPoint(long double b, long double l) : beta(b), lambda(l) {}
};

// Haversine angular distance
inline long double angularDistance(const SphericalPoint& p1, const SphericalPoint& p2) {
    long double dBeta = p2.beta - p1.beta;
    long double dLambda = p2.lambda - p1.lambda;
    long double h = std::sin(dBeta * 0.5L) * std::sin(dBeta * 0.5L) 
                  + std::cos(p1.beta) * std::cos(p2.beta) 
                  * std::sin(dLambda * 0.5L) * std::sin(dLambda * 0.5L);
    return 2.0L * std::asin(clamp(std::sqrt(h), 0.0L, 1.0L));
}

// Forward Azimuth (Bearing) at p1 towards p2
inline long double forwardAzimuth(const SphericalPoint& p1, const SphericalPoint& p2) {
    long double dLambda = p2.lambda - p1.lambda;
    long double y = std::sin(dLambda) * std::cos(p2.beta);
    long double x = std::cos(p1.beta) * std::sin(p2.beta) 
                  - std::sin(p1.beta) * std::cos(p2.beta) * std::cos(dLambda);
    long double az = std::atan2(y, x);
    return az < 0 ? az + 2.0L * WGS84::PI : az;
}

// Interior Angle at vertex B of triangle A-B-C (spherical)
// Uses Law of Cosines for angles: cos(B) = (cos(b) - cos(a)cos(c)) / (sin(a)sin(c))
inline long double interiorAngle(const SphericalPoint& A, const SphericalPoint& B, const SphericalPoint& C) {
    long double a = angularDistance(B, C); // side opposite A
    long double b = angularDistance(A, C); // side opposite B (target vertex)
    long double c = angularDistance(A, B); // side opposite C
    
    long double sin_a = std::sin(a), sin_c = std::sin(c);
    if (sin_a < 1e-18L || sin_c < 1e-18L) return 0.0L; // Degenerate
    
    long double cos_B = (std::cos(b) - std::cos(a) * std::cos(c)) / (sin_a * sin_c);
    return std::acos(clamp(cos_B, -1.0L, 1.0L));
}

// L'Huilier's Theorem for Spherical Excess of Triangle
// tan(E/4) = sqrt( tan(s/2) tan((s-a)/2) tan((s-b)/2) tan((s-c)/2) )
inline long double lhuilierExcess(long double a, long double b, long double c) {
    long double s = 0.5L * (a + b + c);
    long double arg = std::tan(s * 0.5L) 
                    * std::tan((s - a) * 0.5L) 
                    * std::tan((s - b) * 0.5L) 
                    * std::tan((s - c) * 0.5L);
    if (arg <= 0) return 0.0L;
    return 4.0L * std::atan(std::sqrt(arg));
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// Geodesic Polygon Area (Authalic Sphere, L'Huilier Triangulation)
// ------------------------------------------------------------
class GeodesicPolygonArea {
    std::vector<SphericalPoint> vertices_auth_; // CCW order
    bool valid_ = false;

public:
    // Input: Geodetic Lat/Lon in Degrees (WGS84). Assumes CCW winding for positive area.
    explicit GeodesicPolygonArea(const std::vector<std::pair<long double, long double>>& geodetic_vertices_deg) {
        if (geodetic_vertices_deg.size() < 3) return;
        vertices_auth_.reserve(geodetic_vertices_deg.size());
        for (auto& ll : geodetic_vertices_deg) {
            long double phi = ll.first * WGS84::DEG2RAD;
            long double lam = ll.second * WGS84::DEG2RAD;
            vertices_auth_.emplace_back(geodeticToAuthalicLat(phi), lam);
        }
        // Close polygon if not closed
        if (angularDistance(vertices_auth_.front(), vertices_auth_.back()) > 1e-15L) {
            vertices_auth_.push_back(vertices_auth_.front());
        }
        valid_ = true;
    }

    // Area via Fan Triangulation from Vertex 0 using L'Huilier
    // Sum of Excess * R2^2
    long double computeAreaLHuilier() const {
        if (!valid_ || vertices_auth_.size() < 4) return 0.0L; // Need V0, V1, V2, V0
        
        long double total_excess = 0.0L;
        const auto& V0 = vertices_auth_[0];
        size_t n = vertices_auth_.size() - 1; // Exclude duplicate closer
        
        for (size_t i = 1; i + 1 < n; ++i) {
            const auto& V1 = vertices_auth_[i];
            const auto& V2 = vertices_auth_[i + 1];
            
            long double a = angularDistance(V1, V2);
            long double b = angularDistance(V0, V2);
            long double c = angularDistance(V0, V1);
            
            // Check winding/degeneracy via signed area proxy (cross product magnitude in 3D)
            // For production, ensure triangle orientation matches polygon (CCW).
            // L'Huilier returns positive excess. We assume CCW input.
            total_excess += lhuilierExcess(a, b, c);
        }
        return total_excess * WGS84::R2_SQ;
    }

    // Analytical Ground Truth for Spherical Rectangle on Authalic Sphere
    // Assumes polygon is a Lat/Lon rectangle: [lat0, lat1] x [lon0, lon1]
    static long double analyticalAreaRect(long double lat0_deg, long double lat1_deg, 
                                          long double lon0_deg, long double lon1_deg) {
        long double beta0 = geodeticToAuthalicLat(lat0_deg * WGS84::DEG2RAD);
        long double beta1 = geodeticToAuthalicLat(lat1_deg * WGS84::DEG2RAD);
        long double dLambda = (lon1_deg - lon0_deg) * WGS84::DEG2RAD;
        // Area = R^2 * DeltaLambda * (sin(beta1) - sin(beta0))
        return WGS84::R2_SQ * dLambda * (std::sin(beta1) - std::sin(beta0));
    }
};

// ------------------------------------------------------------
// Planar Shoelace Approximation (Local ENU Projection)
// ------------------------------------------------------------
struct Vec3 { long double x, y, z; };

inline Vec3 geodeticToECEF(long double lat, long double lon) {
    long double sinLat = std::sin(lat), cosLat = std::cos(lat);
    long double sinLon = std::sin(lon), cosLon = std::cos(lon);
    long double N = WGS84::a / std::sqrt(1.0L - WGS84::e2 * sinLat * sinLat);
    long double h = 0.0L; // On ellipsoid surface
    return {
        (N + h) * cosLat * cosLon,
        (N + h) * cosLat * sinLon,
        (N * (1.0L - WGS84::e2) + h) * sinLat
    };
}

inline Vec3 operator-(const Vec3& a, const Vec3& b) { return {a.x-b.x, a.y-b.y, a.z-b.z}; }
inline Vec3 cross(const Vec3& a, const Vec3& b) { 
    return {a.y*b.z - a.z*b.y, a.z*b.x - a.x*b.z, a.x*b.y - a.y*b.x}; 
}
inline long double dot(const Vec3& a, const Vec3& b) { return a.x*b.x + a.y*b.y + a.z*b.z; }
inline long double norm(const Vec3& a) { return std::sqrt(dot(a, a)); }

class PlanarShoelace {
    std::vector<Vec3> enu_vertices_;
public:
    explicit PlanarShoelace(const std::vector<std::pair<long double, long double>>& geodetic_vertices_deg) {
        if (geodetic_vertices_deg.size() < 3) return;
        
        // 1. Compute Centroid (approx) for ENU origin
        Vec3 centroid_ecef{0,0,0};
        for (auto& ll : geodetic_vertices_deg) {
            Vec3 p = geodeticToECEF(ll.first * WGS84::DEG2RAD, ll.second * WGS84::DEG2RAD);
            centroid_ecef.x += p.x; centroid_ecef.y += p.y; centroid_ecef.z += p.z;
        }
        long double inv_n = 1.0L / geodetic_vertices_deg.size();
        centroid_ecef.x *= inv_n; centroid_ecef.y *= inv_n; centroid_ecef.z *= inv_n;
        
        // 2. Build ENU Basis at Centroid
        long double clat = centroid_ecef.z / norm(centroid_ecef); // Approx sin(lat)
        long double slat = std::sqrt(1.0L - clat*clat);
        long double clon = centroid_ecef.x / std::sqrt(centroid_ecef.x*centroid_ecef.x + centroid_ecef.y*centroid_ecef.y);
        long double slon = centroid_ecef.y / std::sqrt(centroid_ecef.x*centroid_ecef.x + centroid_ecef.y*centroid_ecef.y);
        
        // East, North, Up vectors (ECEF)
        Vec3 e_E = {-slon, clon, 0};
        Vec3 e_N = {-clat*clon, -clat*slon, slat};
        Vec3 e_U = {slat*clon, slat*slon, clat}; // Not used for planar projection
        
        // 3. Project vertices to ENU Plane (East, North)
        enu_vertices_.reserve(geodetic_vertices_deg.size());
        for (auto& ll : geodetic_vertices_deg) {
            Vec3 p = geodeticToECEF(ll.first * WGS84::DEG2RAD, ll.second * WGS84::DEG2RAD);
            Vec3 d = p - centroid_ecef;
            enu_vertices_.push_back({dot(d, e_E), dot(d, e_N), 0});
        }
    }

    long double computeArea() const {
        if (enu_vertices_.size() < 3) return 0.0L;
        long double area = 0.0L;
        size_t n = enu_vertices_.size();
        for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            size_t j = (i + 1) % n;
            area += enu_vertices_[i].x * enu_vertices_[j].y - enu_vertices_[j].x * enu_vertices_[i].y;
        }
        return std::fabsl(area) * 0.5L;
    }
};

} // namespace s2::geodesy

    using namespace s2::geodesy;
    
    std::cout << std::fixed << std::setprecision(6);

    std::cout << "Authalic Radius R2: " << WGS84::R2 << " m\n";
    std::cout << "Authalic Radius^2:  " << WGS84::R2_SQ << " m^2\n\n";

    long double area_exact = GeodesicPolygonArea::analyticalAreaRect(lat0, lat1, lon0, lon1);

    // --------------------------------------------------------

    std::cout << "Analytical (Authalic Sphere) : " << area_exact << " m^2\n";
    std::cout << "L'Huilier (Fan Triangulation) : " << area_lhuilier << " m^2\n";

#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdbool.h>
#include <stddef.h>
#include <assert.h>
#include <string.h>

#define PERIPH_BASE_ADDR    0x40001000U
#define PERIPH_SIZE         4096U
#define PAGE_SIZE           4096U

#define REG_CTRL            0x00U
#define REG_STATUS          0x04U
#define REG_DATA            0x08U
#define REG_IRQ_MASK        0x0CU

#define CTRL_ENABLE         (1U << 0)
#define CTRL_IRQ_EN         (1U << 1)
#define CTRL_DMA_EN         (1U << 2)
#define CTRL_RST            (1U << 31)

#define STATUS_TX_DONE      (1U << 0)
#define STATUS_RX_DONE      (1U << 1)
#define STATUS_ERR_OVF      (1U << 2)
#define STATUS_ERR_UND      (1U << 3)
#define STATUS_BUSY         (1U << 31)

#define IRQ_MASK_TX_DONE    (1U << 0)
#define IRQ_MASK_RX_DONE    (1U << 1)
#define IRQ_MASK_ERR_OVF    (1U << 2)
#define IRQ_MASK_ERR_UND    (1U << 3)

static uint8_t __attribute__((aligned(PAGE_SIZE))) g_mmio_backing[PERIPH_SIZE];

static inline uint32_t *reg_ptr(uint32_t offset) {
    return (uint32_t *)(g_mmio_backing + offset);
}

static inline void dsb_sy(void) {
    __asm__ volatile ("dsb sy" ::: "memory");
}

static inline void isb_sy(void) {
    __asm__ volatile ("isb sy" ::: "memory");
}

static inline void dmb_sy(void) {
    __asm__ volatile ("dmb sy" ::: "memory");
}

typedef struct {
    volatile uint32_t *ctrl;
    volatile uint32_t *status;
    volatile uint32_t *data;
    volatile uint32_t *irq_mask;
} periph_regs_t;

static periph_regs_t g_periph = {
    .ctrl      = (volatile uint32_t *)(g_mmio_backing + REG_CTRL),
    .status    = (volatile uint32_t *)(g_mmio_backing + REG_STATUS),
    .data      = (volatile uint32_t *)(g_mmio_backing + REG_DATA),
    .irq_mask  = (volatile uint32_t *)(g_mmio_backing + REG_IRQ_MASK)
};

bool periph_init(void) {
    memset(g_mmio_backing, 0, PERIPH_SIZE);
    dsb_sy();
    *g_periph.ctrl = CTRL_RST;
    dsb_sy();
    *g_periph.ctrl = 0;
    dsb_sy();
    *g_periph.irq_mask = 0;
    dsb_sy();
    return true;
}

bool periph_enable(bool enable) {
    uint32_t val = *g_periph.ctrl;
    if (enable) {
        val |= CTRL_ENABLE;
    } else {
        val &= ~CTRL_ENABLE;
    }
    *g_periph.ctrl = val;
    dsb_sy();
    return true;
}

bool periph_set_irq_mask(uint32_t mask) {
    *g_periph.irq_mask = mask & 0xFU;
    dsb_sy();
    return true;
}

uint32_t periph_get_irq_mask(void) {
    return *g_periph.irq_mask & 0xFU;
}

bool periph_write_data(uint32_t data) {
    if (!(*g_periph.ctrl & CTRL_ENABLE)) return false;
    *g_periph.data = data;
    dsb_sy();
    return true;
}

uint32_t periph_read_data(void) {
    return *g_periph.data;
}

uint32_t periph_read_status(void) {
    return *g_periph.status;
}

bool periph_clear_status(uint32_t bits) {
    *g_periph.status = bits & (STATUS_TX_DONE | STATUS_RX_DONE | STATUS_ERR_OVF | STATUS_ERR_UND);
    dsb_sy();
    isb_sy();
    return true;
}

bool periph_is_busy(void) {
    return (*g_periph.status & STATUS_BUSY) != 0;
}

bool periph_wait_idle(uint32_t timeout_cycles) {
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < timeout_cycles; ++i) {
        if (!periph_is_busy()) {
            return true;
        }
        __asm__ volatile ("nop");
    }
    return false;
}

void periph_trigger_tx_done(void) {
    *g_periph.status |= STATUS_TX_DONE;
    dsb_sy();
}

void periph_trigger_rx_done(void) {
    *g_periph.status |= STATUS_RX_DONE;
    dsb_sy();
}

void periph_trigger_overflow(void) {
    *g_periph.status |= STATUS_ERR_OVF;
    dsb_sy();
}

void periph_trigger_underflow(void) {
    *g_periph.status |= STATUS_ERR_UND;
    dsb_sy();
}

void periph_set_busy(bool busy) {
    uint32_t val = *g_periph.status;
    if (busy) val |= STATUS_BUSY;
    else val &= ~STATUS_BUSY;
    *g_periph.status = val;
    dsb_sy();
}

int main(void) {
    assert(periph_init());
    assert((*g_periph.ctrl & CTRL_RST) == 0);
    assert(*g_periph.status == 0);
    assert(*g_periph.irq_mask == 0);
    assert(*g_periph.data == 0);

    periph_set_busy(false);
    assert(!periph_is_busy());

    assert(periph_wait_idle(1000));

    assert(periph_enable(false));
    assert((*g_periph.ctrl & CTRL_ENABLE) == 0);

    return 0;
}

#include <cstdint>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cassert>
#include <vector>
#include <array>
#include <algorithm>
#include <numeric>
#include <chrono>
#include <iostream>
#include <memory>
#include <limits>
#include <type_traits>

namespace otio {

struct Rational {
    int64_t num;
    int64_t den;

    constexpr Rational(int64_t n = 0, int64_t d = 1) noexcept : num(n), den(d) { normalize(); }

    constexpr void normalize() noexcept {
        if (den < 0) { num = -num; den = -den; }
        int64_t g = std::gcd(num, den);
        if (g != 0) { num /= g; den /= g; }
    }

    constexpr double to_double() const noexcept { return static_cast<double>(num) / den; }

    constexpr Rational operator+(const Rational& o) const noexcept {
        return Rational(num * o.den + o.num * den, den * o.den);
    }
    constexpr Rational operator-(const Rational& o) const noexcept {
        return Rational(num * o.den - o.num * den, den * o.den);
    }
    constexpr Rational operator*(const Rational& o) const noexcept {
        return Rational(num * o.num, den * o.den);
    }
    constexpr Rational operator/(const Rational& o) const noexcept {
        return Rational(num * o.den, den * o.num);
    }
    constexpr bool operator<(const Rational& o) const noexcept {
        return num * o.den < o.num * den;
    }
    constexpr bool operator<=(const Rational& o) const noexcept {
        return num * o.den <= o.num * den;
    }
    constexpr bool operator==(const Rational& o) const noexcept {
        return num == o.num && den == o.den;
    }
    constexpr bool operator!=(const Rational& o) const noexcept { return !(*this == o); }
};

struct TimeRange {
    Rational start;
    Rational duration;

    constexpr TimeRange() noexcept = default;
    constexpr TimeRange(Rational s, Rational d) noexcept : start(s), duration(d) {}

    constexpr Rational end() const noexcept { return start + duration; }
    constexpr bool contains(Rational t) const noexcept { return start <= t && t < end(); }
    constexpr bool intersects(const TimeRange& o) const noexcept {
        return start < o.end() && o.start < end();
    }
    constexpr TimeRange intersection(const TimeRange& o) const noexcept {
        Rational s = std::max(start, o.start);
        Rational e = std::min(end(), o.end());
        return (s < e) ? TimeRange(s, e - s) : TimeRange(Rational(0), Rational(0));
    }
};

struct Clip {
    TimeRange source_range;
    TimeRange target_range;
    int track_index;
    void* tensor_data;
    std::array<int64_t, 3> tensor_shape;
    std::array<int64_t, 3> tensor_strides;
};

class AlignedMemoryPool {
    static constexpr size_t ALIGNMENT = 64;
    std::vector<std::byte> buffer_;
    size_t offset_ = 0;
    std::vector<size_t> checkpoints_;

public:
    explicit AlignedMemoryPool(size_t capacity_bytes) {
        buffer_.resize(capacity_bytes + ALIGNMENT - 1);
        offset_ = (reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(buffer_.data()) + ALIGNMENT - 1) & ~(ALIGNMENT - 1);
        offset_ -= reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(buffer_.data());
    }

    void* allocate(size_t bytes) noexcept {
        size_t aligned_bytes = (bytes + ALIGNMENT - 1) & ~(ALIGNMENT - 1);
        if (offset_ + aligned_bytes > buffer_.size()) return nullptr;
        void* ptr = buffer_.data() + offset_;
        offset_ += aligned_bytes;
        return ptr;
    }

    void checkpoint() noexcept { checkpoints_.push_back(offset_); }
    void rollback() noexcept {
        if (!checkpoints_.empty()) {
            offset_ = checkpoints_.back();
            checkpoints_.pop_back();
        }
    }
    void reset() noexcept { offset_ = 0; checkpoints_.clear(); }
    size_t used() const noexcept { return offset_; }
    size_t capacity() const noexcept { return buffer_.size(); }
};

class TensorView {
    void* data_;
    std::array<int64_t, 3> shape_;
    std::array<int64_t, 3> strides_;

public:
    TensorView() noexcept : data_(nullptr), shape_{0,0,0}, strides_{0,0,0} {}
    TensorView(void* data, std::array<int64_t,3> shape, std::array<int64_t,3> strides) noexcept
        : data_(data), shape_(shape), strides_(strides) {}

    void* data() const noexcept { return data_; }
    const std::array<int64_t,3>& shape() const noexcept { return shape_; }
    const std::array<int64_t,3>& strides() const noexcept { return strides_; }

    TensorView permute(std::array<int,3> axes) const noexcept {
        std::array<int64_t,3> new_shape, new_strides;
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) {
            new_shape[i] = shape_[axes[i]];
            new_strides[i] = strides_[axes[i]];
        }
        return TensorView(data_, new_shape, new_strides);
    }

    TensorView slice(int dim, int64_t start, int64_t end) const noexcept {
        assert(dim >= 0 && dim < 3);
        assert(start >= 0 && end <= shape_[dim]);
        std::array<int64_t,3> new_shape = shape_;
        std::array<int64_t,3> new_strides = strides_;
        new_shape[dim] = end - start;
        char* base = static_cast<char*>(data_) + start * strides_[dim];
        return TensorView(base, new_shape, new_strides);
    }
};

class TrackGapResolver {
    AlignedMemoryPool& pool_;
    std::vector<Clip> clips_;
    std::vector<TimeRange> gaps_;

public:
    explicit TrackGapResolver(AlignedMemoryPool& pool) noexcept : pool_(pool) {}

    void add_clip(const Clip& clip) { clips_.push_back(clip); }

    void resolve_gaps(Rational track_start, Rational track_end, Rational frame_rate) noexcept {
        if (clips_.empty()) {
            gaps_.push_back(TimeRange(track_start, track_end - track_start));
            return;
        }

        std::sort(clips_.begin(), clips_.end(),
            [](const Clip& a, const Clip& b) { return a.target_range.start < b.target_range.start; });

        Rational current = track_start;
        for (const auto& clip : clips_) {
            if (current < clip.target_range.start) {
                gaps_.push_back(TimeRange(current, clip.target_range.start - current));
            }
            current = std::max(current, clip.target_range.end());
        }
        if (current < track_end) {
            gaps_.push_back(TimeRange(current, track_end - current));
        }
    }

    const std::vector<TimeRange>& gaps() const noexcept { return gaps_; }
    const std::vector<Clip>& clips() const noexcept { return clips_; }

    void clear() noexcept { clips_.clear(); gaps_.clear(); }
};

class TimeRangeResampler {
    AlignedMemoryPool& pool_;
    Rational frame_rate_;

public:
    TimeRangeResampler(AlignedMemoryPool& pool, Rational frame_rate) noexcept
        : pool_(pool), frame_rate_(frame_rate) {}

    TensorView resample(const TensorView& src, const TimeRange& src_range,
                        const TimeRange& dst_range, int channel_dim = 0) noexcept {
        int64_t src_frames = static_cast<int64_t>((src_range.duration * frame_rate_).to_double() + 0.5);
        int64_t dst_frames = static_cast<int64_t>((dst_range.duration * frame_rate_).to_double() + 0.5);

        if (src_frames <= 0 || dst_frames <= 0) return TensorView();

        std::array<int64_t,3> src_shape = src.shape();
        std::array<int64_t,3> dst_shape = src_shape;
        dst_shape[channel_dim] = dst_frames;

        size_t elem_size = 4;
        size_t dst_bytes = dst_shape[0] * dst_shape[1] * dst_shape[2] * elem_size;
        void* dst_data = pool_.allocate(dst_bytes);
        if (!dst_data) return TensorView();

        std::array<int64_t,3> dst_strides = {
            dst_shape[1] * dst_shape[2] * elem_size,
            dst_shape[2] * elem_size,
            elem_size
        };

        const float* src_ptr = static_cast<const float*>(src.data());
        float* dst_ptr = static_cast<float*>(dst_data);

        double ratio = static_cast<double>(src_frames) / dst_frames;

        for (int64_t c = 0; c < dst_shape[0]; ++c) {
            for (int64_t h = 0; h < dst_shape[1]; ++h) {
                for (int64_t w = 0; w < dst_shape[2]; ++w) {
                    double src_idx = (c * ratio);
                    int64_t src_c = static_cast<int64_t>(src_idx);
                    double frac = src_idx - src_c;
                    src_c = std::min(src_c, src_shape[channel_dim] - 1);

                    size_t src_offset = 0;
                    if (channel_dim == 0) src_offset = src_c * src.strides()[0] + h * src.strides()[1] + w * src.strides()[2];
                    else if (channel_dim == 1) src_offset = h * src.strides()[0] + src_c * src.strides()[1] + w * src.strides()[2];
                    else src_offset = h * src.strides()[0] + w * src.strides()[1] + src_c * src.strides()[2];

                    float val = src_ptr[src_offset / elem_size];
                    if (frac > 0 && src_c + 1 < src_shape[channel_dim]) {
                        size_t src_offset2 = 0;
                        if (channel_dim == 0) src_offset2 = (src_c+1) * src.strides()[0] + h * src.strides()[1] + w * src.strides()[2];
                        else if (channel_dim == 1) src_offset2 = h * src.strides()[0] + (src_c+1) * src.strides()[1] + w * src.strides()[2];
                        else src_offset2 = h * src.strides()[0] + w * src.strides()[1] + (src_c+1) * src.strides()[2];

#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <cassert>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstddef>
#include <iomanip>
#include <iostream>
#include <limits>
#include <vector>

namespace wgs84 {

// WGS84 Ellipsoid Constants
constexpr double a = 6378137.0;           // Semi-major axis (meters)
constexpr double f = 1.0 / 298.257223563; // Flattening
constexpr double e2 = 2 * f - f * f;      // Eccentricity squared

// Authalic Sphere Radius (Equal-Area Sphere)
// R_A = a * sqrt(1 - e^2/2 - ... ) -> Closed form via integral of Gaussian curvature
// R_A^2 = (a^2/2) * (1 + (1-e^2)/e * atanh(e))
constexpr double e = std::sqrt(e2);
constexpr double R_authalic = a * std::sqrt(0.5 * (1.0 + (1.0 - e2) / e * std::atanh(e)));

// Convert Geodetic Latitude (radians) to Authalic Latitude (radians)
// beta = asin( q / q_p )
// q = (1-e^2) * ( sin(phi)/(1-e^2 sin^2 phi) - 1/(2e) ln((1-e sin phi)/(1+e sin phi)) )
// q_p = q(pi/2)
inline double geodetic_to_authalic_lat(double phi) noexcept {
    const double sin_phi = std::sin(phi);
    const double e_sin = e * sin_phi;
    const double denom = 1.0 - e2 * sin_phi * sin_phi;

    // q(phi)
    double q = (1.0 - e2) * (sin_phi / denom);
    if (std::abs(e) > std::numeric_limits<double>::epsilon()) {
        q -= (1.0 - e2) / (2.0 * e) * std::log((1.0 - e_sin) / (1.0 + e_sin));
    }

    // q_p (pole)
    static const double q_p = []() {
        double qp = (1.0 - e2) * (1.0 / (1.0 - e2));
        qp -= (1.0 - e2) / (2.0 * e) * std::log((1.0 - e) / (1.0 + e));
        return qp;
    }();

    const double ratio = q / q_p;
    // Clamp for numerical safety at poles
    return std::asin(std::clamp(ratio, -1.0, 1.0));
}

// 3D Vector on Unit Sphere
struct Vec3 {
    double x, y, z;
    Vec3() = default;
    Vec3(double x_, double y_, double z_) : x(x_), y(y_), z(z_) {}

    Vec3 operator+(const Vec3& o) const { return {x + o.x, y + o.y, z + o.z}; }
    Vec3 operator-(const Vec3& o) const { return {x - o.x, y - o.y, z - o.z}; }
    Vec3 operator*(double s) const { return {x * s, y * s, z * s}; }
};

inline double dot(const Vec3& a, const Vec3& b) noexcept { return a.x * b.x + a.y * b.y + a.z * b.z; }
inline Vec3 cross(const Vec3& a, const Vec3& b) noexcept {
    return {a.y * b.z - a.z * b.y, a.z * b.x - a.x * b.z, a.x * b.y - a.y * b.x};
}
inline double norm(const Vec3& v) noexcept { return std::sqrt(dot(v, v)); }
inline Vec3 normalize(const Vec3& v) noexcept {
    double n = norm(v);
    return (n > 0) ? v * (1.0 / n) : Vec3{0, 0, 0};
}

// Lat/Lon (radians) -> Unit Vector on Authalic Sphere
inline Vec3 to_authalic_vec(double lon, double lat_geodetic) noexcept {
    double beta = geodetic_to_authalic_lat(lat_geodetic);
    double cos_b = std::cos(beta);
    return {cos_b * std::cos(lon), cos_b * std::sin(lon), std::sin(beta)};
}

// Spherical Polygon Area via Girard's Theorem (Vector Form)
// Area = R^2 * ( Sum( exterior_angles ) - (N-2)*pi )
// Exterior angle at vertex i = atan2( |n_i x n_{i+1}|, n_i . n_{i+1} ) * sign( (n_i x n_{i+1}) . n_center )
// Simplified robust implementation: Sum of atan2( |cross|, dot ) for edges, corrected for winding.
// Standard formula: Area = R^2 * [ Sum( atan2( |v_i x v_{i+1}|, v_i . v_{i+1} ) ) - (N-2)*pi ]
// This gives positive area for CCW (vertices ordered counter-clockwise looking from outside).
// For geographic polygons (CCW = interior on left), this matches standard convention.
double spherical_polygon_area(const std::vector<Vec3>& verts) noexcept {
    const size_t n = verts.size();
    if (n < 3) return 0.0;

    double sum_angles = 0.0;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        const Vec3& v1 = verts[i];
        const Vec3& v2 = verts[(i + 1) % n];
        Vec3 cr = cross(v1, v2);
        double cr_norm = norm(cr);
        double dt = dot(v1, v2);
        // atan2(y, x) handles quadrant correctly. Angle is positive.
        sum_angles += std::atan2(cr_norm, dt);
    }

    // Spherical Excess E = Sum(angles) - (N-2)*pi
    double excess = sum_angles - (static_cast<double>(n) - 2.0) * M_PI;
    return excess * R_authalic * R_authalic;
}

// Planar Shoelace on Raw Lat/Lon (Degrees) - Naive Planar Approximation
double planar_shoelace_deg(const std::vector<std::pair<double, double>>& coords_deg) noexcept {
    size_t n = coords_deg.size();
    if (n < 3) return 0.0;
    double sum = 0.0;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        size_t j = (i + 1) % n;
        // x = Lon, y = Lat
        sum += coords_deg[i].first * coords_deg[j].second - coords_deg[j].first * coords_deg[i].second;
    }
    // Result in deg^2. Convert to m^2 using local scale approximation at centroid for "fair" comparison?
    // Prompt asks for "Planar Shoelace Approximation". Raw deg^2 is meaningless.
    // We compute Planar Area in a Local Tangent Plane (ENU) centered at centroid for valid comparison.
    return std::abs(sum) * 0.5; // Returns deg^2
}

// Planar Shoelace in Local ENU (East-North-Up) Projection centered at centroid
// This is the standard "Planar Approximation" used in GIS for small areas.
double planar_shoelace_enu(const std::vector<std::pair<double, double>>& coords_deg) noexcept {
    size_t n = coords_deg.size();
    if (n < 3) return 0.0;

    // 1. Compute Centroid (spherical avg approx)
    double sum_lat = 0, sum_lon = 0;
    for (auto& p : coords_deg) {
        sum_lat += p.second;
        sum_lon += p.first;
    }
    double lat0 = sum_lat / n * M_PI / 180.0;
    double lon0 = sum_lon / n * M_PI / 180.0;

    // 2. Project to Local ENU (meters)
    // Radius of curvature in Prime Vertical (N) and Meridian (M)
    double sin_lat = std::sin(lat0);
    double N = a / std::sqrt(1.0 - e2 * sin_lat * sin_lat);
    double M = N * (1.0 - e2) / (1.0 - e2 * sin_lat * sin_lat);

    std::vector<std::pair<double, double>> enu;
    enu.reserve(n);
    for (auto& p : coords_deg) {
        double dLon = (p.first * M_PI / 180.0) - lon0;
        double dLat = (p.second * M_PI / 180.0) - lat0;
        double E = dLon * N * std::cos(lat0);
        double N_ = dLat * M;
        enu.emplace_back(E, N_);
    }

    // 3. Shoelace on ENU (meters)
    double sum = 0.0;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        size_t j = (i + 1) % n;
        sum += enu[i].first * enu[j].second - enu[j].first * enu[i].second;
    }
    return std::abs(sum) * 0.5;
}

} // namespace wgs84

// ========================================================================
// Test Harness: Svalbard High-Latitude Polygon
// ========================================================================

int main() {
    using namespace wgs84;

    // Svalbard Test Polygon: ~10km x 10km square near 78.22 N, 15.6 E
    // Vertices defined CCW (Standard GIS winding: Interior on Left)
    std::vector<std::pair<double, double>> polygon_ccw_deg = {
        {15.50, 78.20}, // SW
        {15.70, 78.20}, // SE
        {15.70, 78.24}, // NE
        {15.50, 78.24}  // NW
    };

    // CW Version (Reversed)
    std::vector<std::pair<double, double>> polygon_cw_deg = polygon_ccw_deg;
    std::reverse(polygon_cw_deg.begin(), polygon_cw_deg.end());

    auto run_test = [](const char* label, const std::vector<std::pair<double, double>>& poly_deg) {
        std::cout << "\n=== " << label << " ===\n";

        // 1. Geodesic Area (Authalic Sphere / Spherical Excess)
        std::vector<Vec3> verts_authalic;
        verts_authalic.reserve(poly_deg.size());
        for (auto& p : poly_deg) {
            double lon = p.first * M_PI / 180.0;
            double lat = p.second * M_PI / 180.0;
            verts_authalic.push_back(to_authalic_vec(lon, lat));
        }
        double area_geodesic = spherical_polygon_area(verts_authalic);
        // Area sign indicates winding (CCW > 0 on Authalic Sphere looking from origin)
        // Geographic CCW -> Positive Area.

        // 2. Planar Approximation (Local ENU)
        double area_planar_enu = planar_shoelace_enu(poly_deg);

        // 3. Naive Planar (Deg^2) - just for reference of distortion magnitude
        double area_naive_deg2 = planar_shoelace_deg(poly_deg);

        std::cout << std::fixed << std::setprecision(3);
        std::cout << "Geodesic Area (Authalic Sphere): " << area_geodesic << " m^2\n";
        std::cout << "Planar Area (Local ENU):         " << area_planar_enu << " m^2\n";
        std::cout << "Naive Planar (deg^2):            " << area_naive_deg2 << " deg^2\n";

        double rel_error = std::abs(area_planar_enu - std::abs(area_geodesic)) / std::abs(area_geodesic);
        std::cout << "Relative Error (Planar vs Geo):  " << rel_error * 100.0 << " %\n";

        // Verification: Winding Order Determinism
        // CCW should yield positive excess (area). CW negative.
        // We assert magnitude equality.
        return std::abs(area_geodesic);
    };

    double area_ccw = run_test("Svalbard Polygon (CCW Winding)", polygon_ccw_deg);
    double area_cw  = run_test("Svalbard Polygon (CW Winding)", polygon_cw_deg);

    // Assertions
    const double TOL_AREA = 1e-6; // Relative tolerance for winding invariance
    assert(std::abs(area_ccw - area_cw) / area_ccw < TOL_AREA && "Winding order magnitude mismatch!");

    // Accuracy Assertion: At 78N, 10km polygon, Planar ENU error should be small (< 0.1% typically for 10km)
    // but non-zero. We verify the geodesic calculation runs and produces plausible values (~100 km^2).
    assert(area_ccw > 90e6 && area_ccw < 110e6 && "Geodesic area out of expected bounds for 10km square");

    std::cout << "\n[SUCCESS] All invariants verified: Winding determinism & Geodetic plausibility.\n";
    std::cout << "Geodesic Area: " << area_ccw << " m^2 (" << area_ccw / 1e6 << " km^2)\n";

    return 0;
}
```

**Complexity Note:**
*   **Time:** $O(N)$ for $N$ vertices. Authalic latitude conversion involves transcendental functions ($\log, \sqrt, \text{atanh}$) per vertex. Spherical excess summation is $O(N)$ vector ops.
*   **Space:** $O(N)$ for vertex storage.

    int64_t numerator;
    int64_t denominator;
    
    // Normalize rational (keep denominator positive)
    void normalize() {
        if (denominator < 0) {
            numerator = -numerator;
            denominator = -denominator;
        }
        int64_t g = std::gcd(std::abs(numerator), denominator);
        numerator /= g;
        denominator /= g;
    }
    
    // Comparison operators
    bool operator==(const RationalTime& other) const {
        return numerator * other.denominator == other.numerator * denominator;
    }
    bool operator<(const RationalTime& other) const {
        return numerator * other.denominator < other.numerator * denominator;
    }
    bool operator<=(const RationalTime& other) const {
        return *this < other || *this == other;
    }
    
    // Arithmetic
    RationalTime operator+(const RationalTime& other) const {
        RationalTime result{
            numerator * other.denominator + other.numerator * denominator,
            denominator * other.denominator
        };
        result.normalize();
        return result;
    }
    
    RationalTime operator-(const RationalTime& other) const {
        RationalTime result{
            numerator * other.denominator - other.numerator * denominator,
            denominator * other.denominator
        };
        result.normalize();
        return result;
    }
    
    RationalTime operator*(int64_t scalar) const {
        RationalTime result{numerator * scalar, denominator};
        result.normalize();
        return result;
    }
    
    double to_double() const {
        return static_cast<double>(numerator) / static_cast<double>(denominator);
    }
};

// Time range
struct TimeRange {
    RationalTime start_time;
    RationalTime duration;
    
    RationalTime end_time_exclusive() const {
        return start_time + duration;
    }
    
    bool contains(const RationalTime& t) const {
        return t >= start_time && t < end_time_exclusive();
    }
    
    bool overlaps(const TimeRange& other) const {
        return start_time < other.end_time_exclusive() && 
               other.start_time < end_time_exclusive();
    }
    
    std::optional<TimeRange> intersection(const TimeRange& other) const {
        RationalTime start = std::max(start_time, other.start_time);
        RationalTime end = std::min(end_time_exclusive(), other.end_time_exclusive());
        if (start < end) {
            return TimeRange{start, end - start};
        }
        return std::nullopt;
    }
};

// Clip on a track
struct Clip {
    TimeRange source_range;    // Range in source media
    TimeRange target_range;    // Range on timeline
    int64_t media_id;          // Source media identifier
    
    bool is_gap() const { return media_id == -1; }
};

// Track with clips
struct Track {
    std::vector<Clip> clips;
    RationalTime duration;     // Track duration
    
    // Pre-allocated gap buffer for hot path
    mutable std::vector<TimeRange> gap_buffer;
    
    void reserve_gaps(size_t capacity) {
        gap_buffer.reserve(capacity);
    }
    
    // Find gaps in track (hot path - zero allocation after reserve)
    const std::vector<TimeRange>& find_gaps() const {
        gap_buffer.clear();
        
        if (clips.empty()) {
            if (duration.numerator > 0) {
                gap_buffer.push_back(TimeRange{RationalTime{0, 1}, duration});
            }
            return gap_buffer;
        }
        
        // Sort clips by target start time
        // In production, clips would be maintained sorted
        // For this implementation, we assume they're sorted
        
        RationalTime current_time{0, 1};
        
        for (const auto& clip : clips) {
            if (clip.target_range.start_time > current_time) {
                gap_buffer.push_back(TimeRange{current_time, 
                    clip.target_range.start_time - current_time});
            }
            current_time = clip.target_range.end_time_exclusive();
        }
        
        if (current_time < duration) {
            gap_buffer.push_back(TimeRange{current_time, duration - current_time});
        }
        
        return gap_buffer;
    }
    
    // Resolve gaps by extending adjacent clips or inserting filler
    void resolve_gaps(bool extend_adjacent = true) {
        auto gaps = find_gaps();
        if (gaps.empty()) return;
        
        std::vector<Clip> new_clips;
        new_clips.reserve(clips.size() + gaps.size());
        
        size_t clip_idx = 0;
        RationalTime current_time{0, 1};
        
        for (const auto& gap : gaps) {
            // Add clips before this gap
            while (clip_idx < clips.size() && 
                   clips[clip_idx].target_range.end_time_exclusive() <= gap.start_time) {
                new_clips.push_back(clips[clip_idx++]);
            }
            
            if (extend_adjacent && clip_idx > 0 && clip_idx < clips.size()) {
                // Extend previous clip to fill gap
                Clip& prev = new_clips.back();
                RationalTime extension = gap.duration;
                prev.target_range.duration = prev.target_range.duration + extension;
                prev.source_range.duration = prev.source_range.duration + extension;
                current_time = gap.end_time_exclusive();
            } else {
                // Insert gap filler clip
                new_clips.push_back(Clip{
                    TimeRange{gap.start_time, gap.duration},
                    TimeRange{gap.start_time, gap.duration},
                    -1  // gap marker
                });
                current_time = gap.end_time_exclusive();
            }
        }
        
        // Add remaining clips
        while (clip_idx < clips.size()) {
            new_clips.push_back(clips[clip_idx++]);
        }
        
        clips = std::move(new_clips);
    }
};

// Zero-copy 3D tensor view with stride permutation
template<typename T>
class Tensor3DView {
public:
    using value_type = T;
    using pointer = T*;
    using const_pointer = const T*;
    using size_type = size_t;
    
    // Stride order: [dim0_stride, dim1_stride, dim2_stride]
    // Default: row-major (C-contiguous): [dim1*dim2, dim2, 1]
    
    Tensor3DView() = default;
    
    Tensor3DView(pointer data, 
                 size_type dim0, size_type dim1, size_type dim2,
                 std::array<size_type, 3> strides = {})
        : data_(data), dims_{dim0, dim1, dim2} {
        if (strides.empty()) {
            // Default row-major strides
            strides_[0] = dim1 * dim2;
            strides_[1] = dim2;
            strides_[2] = 1;
        } else {
            strides_ = strides;
        }
    }
    
    // Permute dimensions (zero-copy, just changes stride/view)
    Tensor3DView permute(std::array<int, 3> new_order) const {
        assert(new_order[0] >= 0 && new_order[0] < 3);
        assert(new_order[1] >= 0 && new_order[1] < 3);
        assert(new_order[2] >= 0 && new_order[2] < 3);
        assert(new_order[0] != new_order[1] && new_order[0] != new_order[2] && new_order[1] != new_order[2]);
        
        std::array<size_type, 3> new_dims;
        std::array<size_type, 3> new_strides;
        
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) {
            new_dims[i] = dims_[new_order[i]];
            new_strides[i] = strides_[new_order[i]];
        }
        
        return Tensor3DView(data_, new_dims[0], new_dims[1], new_dims[2], new_strides);
    }
    
    // Transpose (swap two dimensions)
    Tensor3DView transpose(int dim0, int dim1) const {
        std::array<int, 3> order = {0, 1, 2};
        std::swap(order[dim0], order[dim1]);
        return permute(order);
    }
    
    // Access element (with bounds checking in debug)
    T& operator()(size_type i, size_type j, size_type k) {
        assert(i < dims_[0] && j < dims_[1] && k < dims_[2]);
        return data_[i * strides_[0] + j * strides_[1] + k * strides_[2]];
    }
    
    const T& operator()(size_type i, size_type j, size_type k) const {
        assert(i < dims_[0] && j < dims_[1] && k < dims_[2]);
        return data_[i * strides_[0] + j * strides_[1] + k * strides_[2]];
    }
    
    // Raw pointer access for NumPy/Pybind11 interop
    pointer data() { return data_; }
    const_pointer data() const { return data_; }
    
    // Shape and strides for NumPy array creation
    std::array<size_type, 3> shape() const { return dims_; }
    std::array<size_type, 3> strides() const { return strides_; }
    std::array<size_type, 3> strides_bytes() const { 
        return {strides_[0] * sizeof(T), strides_[1] * sizeof(T), strides_[2] * sizeof(T)}; 
    }
    
    size_type size() const { return dims_[0] * dims_[1] * dims_[2]; }
    size_type ndim() const { return 3; }
    
    // Check if contiguous
    bool is_contiguous() const {
        return strides_[0] == dims_[1] * dims_[2] && 
               strides_[1] == dims_[2] && 
               strides_[2] == 1;
    }
    
private:
    pointer data_ = nullptr;
    std::array<size_type, 3> dims_ = {0, 0, 0};
    std::array<size_type, 3> strides_ = {0, 0, 0};
};

// Resampler for rational time ranges
class RationalTimeResampler {
public:
    // Resample clips from source rate to target rate
    static void resample_track(Track& track, 
                               const RationalTime& source_rate,
                               const RationalTime& target_rate) {
        if (source_rate == target_rate) return;
        
        // Conversion factor: target_rate / source_rate
        RationalTime factor{
            target_rate.numerator * source_rate.denominator,
            target_rate.denominator * source_rate.numerator
        };
        factor.normalize();
        
        for (auto& clip : track.clips) {
            // Resample source range
            clip.source_range.start_time = multiply_rational(clip.source_range.start_time, factor);
            clip.source_range.duration = multiply_rational(clip.source_range.duration, factor);
            
            // Resample target range
            clip.target_range.start_time = multiply_rational(clip.target_range.start_time, factor);
            clip.target_range.duration = multiply_rational(clip.target_range.duration, factor);
        }
        
        // Resample track duration
        track.duration = multiply_rational(track.duration, factor);
    }
    
    // Resample a time range
    static TimeRange resample_range(const TimeRange& range,
                                    const RationalTime& source_rate,
                                    const RationalTime& target_rate) {
        RationalTime factor{
            target_rate.numerator * source_rate.denominator,
            target_rate.denominator * source_rate.numerator
        };
        factor.normalize();
        
        return TimeRange{
            multiply_rational(range.start_time, factor),
            multiply_rational(range.duration, factor)
        };
    }
    
private:
    static RationalTime multiply_rational(const RationalTime& a, const RationalTime& b) {
        RationalTime result{a.numerator * b.numerator, a.denominator * b.denominator};
        result.normalize();
        return result;
    }
};

// Media timeline composer (OpenTimelineIO style)
class TimelineComposer {
public:
    struct CompositionResult {
        std::vector<Clip> composed_clips;
        std::vector<TimeRange> unresolved_gaps;
        bool success = true;
    };
    
    // Compose multiple tracks into single timeline
    static CompositionResult compose_tracks(const std::vector<Track*>& tracks,
                                            const RationalTime& timeline_duration) {
        CompositionResult result;
        
        // Collect all clips from all tracks
        std::vector<Clip> all_clips;
        size_t total_clips = 0;
        for (const auto* track : tracks) {
            total_clips += track->clips.size();
        }
        all_clips.reserve(total_clips);
        
        for (const auto* track : tracks) {
            for (const auto& clip : track->clips) {
                all_clips.push_back(clip);
            }
        }
        
        // Sort by target start time
        std::sort(all_clips.begin(), all_clips.end(),
                  [](const Clip& a, const Clip& b) {
                      return a.target_range.start_time < b.target_range.start_time;
                  });
        
        // Merge overlapping clips (higher track index wins - last in vector)
        std::vector<Clip> merged;
        merged.reserve(all_clips.size());
        
        for (const auto& clip : all_clips) {
            if (merged.empty() || !merged.back().target_range.overlaps(clip.target_range)) {
                merged.push_back(clip);
            } else {
                // Overlap - clip wins (replace overlapping portion)
                auto& last = merged.back();
                auto intersection = last.target_range.intersection(clip.target_range);
                if (intersection) {
                    // Split last clip if needed
                    if (last.target_range.start_time < intersection->start_time) {
                        // Keep prefix of last clip
                        Clip prefix = last;
                        prefix.target_range.duration = intersection->start_time - last.target_range.start_time;
                        prefix.source_range.duration = intersection->start_time - last.source_range.start_time;
                        merged.back() = prefix;
                        
                        // Add the new clip
                        merged.push_back(clip);
                        
                        // Add suffix of last clip if it extends beyond
                        if (last.target_range.end_time_exclusive() > intersection->end_time_exclusive()) {
                            Clip suffix = last;
                            suffix.target_range.start_time = intersection->end_time_exclusive();
                            suffix.target_range.duration = last.target_range.end_time_exclusive() - intersection->end_time_exclusive();
                            suffix.source_range.start_time = intersection->end_time_exclusive() - last.target_range.start_time + last.source_range.start_time;
                            suffix.source_range.duration = last.target_range.end_time_exclusive() - intersection->end_time_exclusive();
                            merged.push_back(suffix);
                        }
                    } else {
                        // New clip completely covers or starts at same time
                        merged.back() = clip;
                    }
                } else {
                    merged.push_back(clip);
                }
            }
        }
        
        // Find gaps in composed timeline
        RationalTime current_time{0, 1};
        for (const auto& clip : merged) {
            if (clip.target_range.start_time > current_time) {
                result.unresolved_gaps.push_back(
                    TimeRange{current_time, clip.target_range.start_time - current_time}
                );
            }
            current_time = clip.target_range.end_time_exclusive();
        }
        
        if (current_time < timeline_duration) {
            result.unresolved_gaps.push_back(
                TimeRange{current_time, timeline_duration - current_time}
            );
        }
        
        result.composed_clips = std::move(merged);
        return result;
    }
};

void test_rational_time() {
    RationalTime a{1, 24};    // 1/24 sec (1 frame at 24fps)
    RationalTime b{1, 30};    // 1/30 sec (1 frame at 30fps)
    
    assert(a < RationalTime{1, 12});
    assert(RationalTime{2, 24} == RationalTime{1, 12});
    assert((a + b).numerator == 54 && (a + b).denominator == 720); // 1/24 + 1/30 = 9/120 = 3/40
    assert((a - RationalTime{1, 48}).numerator == 1 && (a - RationalTime{1, 48}).denominator == 48);
    
    // Test normalization with negative
    RationalTime neg{-1, 24};
    neg.normalize();
    assert(neg.numerator == -1 && neg.denominator == 24);
    
    RationalTime neg_denom{1, -24};
    neg_denom.normalize();
    assert(neg_denom.numerator == -1 && neg_denom.denominator == 24);
}

void test_time_range() {
    TimeRange r1{RationalTime{0, 1}, RationalTime{10, 1}};  // [0, 10)
    TimeRange r2{RationalTime{5, 1}, RationalTime{10, 1}};   // [5, 15)
    TimeRange r3{RationalTime{10, 1}, RationalTime{5, 1}};   // [10, 15)
    TimeRange r4{RationalTime{15, 1}, RationalTime{5, 1}};   // [15, 20)
    
    assert(r1.overlaps(r2));
    assert(!r1.overlaps(r3));  // Exact boundary - no overlap
    assert(!r1.overlaps(r4));
    
    auto inter = r1.intersection(r2);
    assert(inter.has_value());
    assert(inter->start_time == RationalTime{5, 1});
    assert(inter->duration == RationalTime{5, 1});
    
    auto inter2 = r1.intersection(r3);
    assert(!inter2.has_value());  // Exact boundary
    
    assert(r1.contains(RationalTime{0, 1}));
    assert(r1.contains(RationalTime{9, 1}));
    assert(!r1.contains(RationalTime{10, 1}));  // Exclusive end
    assert(!r1.contains(RationalTime{-1, 1}));
}

void test_track_gaps() {
    Track track;
    track.duration = RationalTime{100, 1};
    track.reserve_gaps(10);
    
    // Empty track - entire duration is gap
    auto gaps = track.find_gaps();
    assert(gaps.size() == 1);
    assert(gaps[0].start_time == RationalTime{0, 1});
    assert(gaps[0].duration == RationalTime{100, 1});
    
    // Add clips
    track.clips = {
        Clip{TimeRange{RationalTime{0, 1}, RationalTime{10, 1}}, 
             TimeRange{RationalTime{0, 1}, RationalTime{10, 1}}, 1},
        Clip{TimeRange{RationalTime{10, 1}, RationalTime{10, 1}}, 
             TimeRange{RationalTime{20, 1}, RationalTime{10, 1}}, 2},  // Gap [10, 20)
        Clip{TimeRange{RationalTime{20, 1}, RationalTime{10, 1}}, 
             TimeRange{RationalTime{30, 1}, RationalTime{10, 1}}, 3},
    };
    
    gaps = track.find_gaps();
    assert(gaps.size() == 2);
    assert(gaps[0].start_time == RationalTime{10, 1});
    assert(gaps[0].duration == RationalTime{10, 1});
    assert(gaps[1].start_time == RationalTime{40, 1});
    assert(gaps[1].duration == RationalTime{60, 1});
    
    // Test gap resolution by extending
    track.resolve_gaps(true);
    assert(track.clips.size() == 3);
    // First clip extended to cover [0, 20)
    assert(track.clips[0].target_range.duration == RationalTime{20, 1});
    // Second clip now starts at 20
    assert(track.clips[1].target_range.start_time == RationalTime{20, 1});
    
    // Test gap resolution with filler
    Track track2;
    track2.duration = RationalTime{100, 1};
    track2.reserve_gaps(10);
    track2.clips = {
        Clip{TimeRange{RationalTime{0, 1}, RationalTime{10, 1}}, 
             TimeRange{RationalTime{0, 1}, RationalTime{10, 1}}, 1},
        Clip{TimeRange{RationalTime{10, 1}, RationalTime{10, 1}}, 
             TimeRange{RationalTime{30, 1}, RationalTime{10, 1}}, 2},
    };
    track2.resolve_gaps(false);
    assert(track2.clips.size() == 3);
    assert(track2.clips[1].is_gap());
    assert(track2.clips[1].target_range.start_time == RationalTime{10, 1});
    assert(track2.clips[1].target_range.duration == RationalTime{20, 1});
}

void test_resampler() {
    Track track;
    track.duration = RationalTime{100, 1};
    track.clips = {
        Clip{TimeRange{RationalTime{0, 1}, RationalTime{24, 1}}, 
             TimeRange{RationalTime{0, 1}, RationalTime{24, 1}}, 1},
        Clip{TimeRange{RationalTime{24, 1}, RationalTime{24, 1}}, 
             TimeRange{RationalTime{24, 1}, RationalTime{24, 1}}, 2},
    };
    
    // Resample from 24fps to 30fps
    RationalTime source_rate{1, 24};
    RationalTime target_rate{1, 30};
    
    RationalTimeResampler::resample_track(track, source_rate, target_rate);
    
    // 24 frames at 24fps = 1 second = 30 frames at 30fps
    assert(track.clips[0].target_range.duration == RationalTime{30, 30});  // 1 second
    assert(track.clips[1].target_range.duration == RationalTime{30, 30});  // 1 second
    assert(track.duration == RationalTime{60, 30});  // 2 seconds
}

void test_tensor3d_permute() {
    // Create 3D data: 2x3x4 = 24 elements
    std::vector<float> data(24);
    std::iota(data.begin(), data.end(), 0.0f);
    
    // Row-major view: [2, 3, 4] with strides [12, 4, 1]
    Tensor3DView<float> view(data.data(), 2, 3, 4);
    assert(view.is_contiguous());
    
    // Test access
    assert(view(0, 0, 0) == 0.0f);
    assert(view(0, 0, 3) == 3.0f);
    assert(view(0, 1, 0) == 4.0f);
    assert(view(1, 0, 0) == 12.0f);
    assert(view(1, 2, 3) == 23.0f);
    
    // Permute to [4, 2, 3] (swap dim0 and dim2)
    auto permuted = view.permute({2, 0, 1});
    assert(permuted.shape() == std::array<size_t, 3>{4, 2, 3});
    assert(permuted.strides() == std::array<size_t, 3>{1, 12, 4});
    
    // Verify data access through permuted view
    assert(permuted(0, 0, 0) == 0.0f);   // Original (0,0,0)
    assert(permuted(3, 0, 0) == 3.0f);   // Original (0,0,3)
    assert(permuted(0, 0, 1) == 4.0f);   // Original (0,1,0)
    assert(permuted(0, 1, 0) == 12.0f);  // Original (1,0,0)
    assert(permuted(3, 1, 2) == 23.0f);  // Original (1,2,3)
    
    // Transpose (swap dim 0 and 1)
    auto transposed = view.transpose(0, 1);
    assert(transposed.shape() == std::array<size_t, 3>{3, 2, 4});
    assert(transposed.strides() == std::array<size_t, 3>{4, 12, 1});
    assert(transposed(0, 0, 0) == 0.0f);
    assert(transposed(1, 0, 0) == 4.0f);
    assert(transposed(0, 1, 0) == 12.0f);
    
    // Test strides_bytes for NumPy interop
    auto strides_bytes = view.strides_bytes();
    assert(strides_bytes[0] == 12 * sizeof(float));
    assert(strides_bytes[1] == 4 * sizeof(float));
    assert(strides_bytes[2] == 1 * sizeof(float));
}

             TimeRange{RationalTime{50, 1}, RationalTime{30, 1}}, 2},
    };

    };

    assert(result.composed_clips[2].media_id == 2);

    track3.duration = RationalTime{100, 1};
    track4.duration = RationalTime{100, 1};
    track3.clips = {Clip{TimeRange{RationalTime{0, 1}, RationalTime{50, 1}}, 
                         TimeRange{RationalTime{0, 1}, RationalTime{50, 1}}, 1}};
    track4.clips = {Clip{TimeRange{RationalTime{0, 1}, RationalTime{50, 1}}, 
                         TimeRange{RationalTime{50, 1}, RationalTime{50, 1}}, 2}};
    
    auto result2 = TimelineComposer::compose_tracks({&track3, &track4}, RationalTime{100, 1});
    assert(result2.composed_clips.size() == 2);
    assert(result2.unresolved_gaps.empty());
}

void test_edge_cases() {

#include <cstdint>
#include <vector>
